LESSON: SAFETY IN THE HOME

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE
Strand: Home Management
Topic 2.2: Safety in the Home
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Safety in the Home, part of Home Management in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How can we ensure safety in the home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. share experiences on causes of accidents and injuries that occur at home (include preventive measures).

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. share experiences on causes of accidents and injuries that occur at home (include preventive measures).

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Safety in the Home together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: Learners interact with technology as they search for information on the contents of the First Aid kit.

● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Learners evaluate and make decisions on First Aid items to improvise using

locally available materials.

Values:
● Integrity: Learner utilises resources prudently when improvising the First Aid kit using locally available materials.

● Love: Learners portray a caring attitude when carrying out First Aid for various injuries at home.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Waste Management: The learner disposes of used First Aid materials appropriately.

● Road Safety: The learner is made aware of how to carry out First Aid for various injuries that occur at home and even on

the road using appropriate First Aid items.

Suggested learning resources:

Adapted digital devices and print reference materials, first aid kit, general accessible environment for space/rooms to simulate

first aid for various injuries
